questions.q: There are _____ apples on the table.
questions.hint: apples 是可数名词复数，用 a few 表示一些。
questions.sentence: There are a few apples on the table.
questions.zh: 桌子上有几个苹果。

questions.q: There is _____ water in the bottle. Please drink more.
questions.hint: water 是不可数名词，little 表示几乎没有，含否定。
questions.sentence: There is little water in the bottle. Please drink more.
questions.zh: 瓶子里几乎没有水了，请多喝点。

questions.q: I have _____ friends in Chengdu. They are nice.
questions.hint: friends 是可数名词复数，a few 表示几个。
questions.sentence: I have a few friends in Chengdu. They are nice.
questions.zh: 我在成都有几个朋友，他们很好。

questions.hint: time 不可数，little 表示几乎没有。
questions.sentence: She has little time to watch TV, so she is busy.
questions.zh: 她几乎没有时间看电视，所以她很忙。

scenes.title: 可数名词用 a few / few
scenes.lead: 记住：可数名词复数前用 a few 表示“几个”，用 few 表示“几乎没有”。
scenes.sentence: There are a few apples on the table, but few oranges.
scenes.zh: 桌子上有几个苹果，但几乎没有橘子。

scenes.title: 不可数名词用 a little / little
scenes.lead: 记住：不可数名词前用 a little 表示“一点”，用 little 表示“几乎没有”。
scenes.sentence: There is a little water in the cup, but little juice.
scenes.zh: 杯子里有一点水，但几乎没有果汁。

scenes.title: 区别 a few/a little 与 few/little
scenes.lead: 带 a 表示“有一些”，不带 a 表示“几乎没有”，注意名词的可数性。
scenes.sentence: I have a few friends and a little time, so I am happy.
scenes.zh: 我有几个朋友和一点时间，所以我很开心。
